scope: Current official Plaza Singapura outlet listings matched to existing SFA records at postal code 238839 using exact licence ID, outlet identity and overlapping unit. Proposed only blank facts supported by current official mall/operator pages. No delivery-platform information used.
method: Inspected prior snapshots for Plaza Singapura; no official mall-directory batch was present. Downloaded official CapitaLand pages (HTTP 200), recorded response byte length and SHA-256 of raw HTML, and confirmed the rendered/indexed official page fields against those responses. Local TLS trust validation fails in this environment, so curl raw-page retrieval used -k; URLs are the official capitaland.com domain. Nonblank workbook fields were preserved. Outlet hours were proposed only where an outlet detail page explicitly gave them; no current explicit Plaza-specific hours were found among proposals.

held_records.issue: Historical CapitaLand CNY hours PDF (around 2020) listed Greendot at #B2-52/54. Current official Plaza directory results reviewed did not surface a current exact outlet listing; CapitaLand brand-wide page does not list Plaza Singapura among its shown locations. This suggests a location/status conflict but does not prove closure. Leave F&B Name blank and do not mark closed until a current exact outlet source confirms identity or permanent closure.

Official CapitaLand page describes Kopitiam at #06-15 to 17 and gives food-court contact/hours, but this multi-tenant food court has numerous separate SFA licences at the same unit. Do not copy venue-wide contact/hours into one licence without establishing outlet-level scope. The same location also has W98413J001 Kopitiam Investment Pte Ltd, adding record ambiguity.

closure_review.note: No permanent closure was confirmed in this mall-directory pass. The Greendot mismatch is held as an unresolved status lead, not treated as closure evidence.
